legend: On the Ovine Island, you are in charge of a herd of big fat sheeps.

To protect them from big bad wolves, you have arranged them into an n×m$$$n \times m$$$ rectangular pen (n,m≤2000$$$n,m \le 2000$$$). Each cell in the pen is either empty (weight 0$$$0$$$) or contains a sheep with weight gi,j,$$$g_{i,j},$$$ an integer between [1,106]$$$[1,10^6]$$$.
Your boss is wondering if there are special properties of the weights of your sheep.

You are given q$$$q$$$ queries, each describing a rectangle. For each rectangle, consider all non-empty weights inside it. Determine whether you can choose three different cells in the rectangle such that if their weights are a,b,c$$$a,b,c$$$, then the largest of them is strictly less than half of their sum: max(a,b,c)<a+b+c2.$$\max(a,b,c)  \lt  \frac{a+b+c}{2}.$$
input: The first line contains two integers n$$$n$$$ and m$$$m$$$ (1≤n,m≤2000$$$1 \le n,m \le 2000$$$).
The next n$$$n$$$ lines each contain m$$$m$$$ integers gi,j$$$g_{i,j}$$$ (0≤gi,j≤106$$$0 \le g_{i,j} \le 10^6$$$), where gi,j=0$$$g_{i,j}=0$$$ means the cell is empty.
The next line contains an integer q$$$q$$$ (1≤q≤105$$$1 \le q \le 10^5$$$).

Each of the next q$$$q$$$ lines contains four integers x1,y1,x2,y2$$$x_1,y_1,x_2,y_2$$$ (1≤x1≤x2≤n$$$1 \le x_1 \le x_2 \le n$$$, 1≤y1≤y2≤m$$$1 \le y_1 \le y_2 \le m$$$), describing a rectangle with corners (x1,y1)$$$(x_1,y_1)$$$ and (x2,y2)$$$(x_2,y_2)$$$ (inclusive).
output: For each query, print YES (case-insensitive) if there exist three different non-empty cells inside the rectangle whose weights satisfy max(a,b,c)<a+b+c2,$$\max(a,b,c)  \lt  \frac{a+b+c}{2},$$ and print NO (case-insensitive) otherwise.
note: This rectangle covers the entire grid. The non-empty weights inside are: {1,2,3,10,4}$$$\{1,2,3,10,4\}$$$.
We need three different cells with weights a,b,c$$$a,b,c$$$ such that max(a,b,c)<a+b+c2.$$$\max(a,b,c)  \lt  \frac{a+b+c}{2}.$$$
Therefore, the answer for Query 1 is YES$$$\texttt{YES}$$$.
This rectangle covers row 2$$$2$$$ and columns 1$$$1$$$ through 3$$$3$$$. The non-empty weights inside are: {2,3,10}$$$\{2,3,10\}$$$.
Since 10≮7.5$$$10 \not \lt  7.5$$$, the condition does not hold.
Therefore, the answer for Query 2 is NO$$$\texttt{NO}$$$.
